node.statement: Distinguish u_pol and u_grp. By 1.7.4, (u_pol,h_pol) is the unique inverse of the explicit typed map Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H. By 1.7.5 and 1.7.5.3, the group-laws external supplies its conclusions for u_grp but supplies neither a companion h nor either inverse identity for this explicit Pi_delta. Uniqueness can compare two candidates only after both are shown to be inverses of the same map with the same source and target; that antecedent is absent here. Therefore u_grp=u_pol cannot be inferred, and the group-law conclusions cannot be transported to the root-bound u_pol from the registered inputs.
